rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for food, drink, or medicine that restores health or strength.

example.english: This chicken soup is very restorative and just right to drink after an illness.
example.traditional: 呢碗雞湯好補身，病後飲啱晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 gai1 tong1 hou2 bou2 san1 beng6 hau6 jam2 ngaam1 saai3

rows.jyutping: fui1 fuk6 tai2 lik6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this specifically for something that helps a tired person regain physical energy, such as a drink, meal, or rest.

example.english: When I’m tired, I drink restorative fruit juice and feel refreshed right away.
example.traditional: 攰嗰陣飲杯恢復體力嘅果汁，成個人即刻精神晒。
example.jyutping: gui6 go2 zan6 jam2 bui1 fui1 fuk6 tai2 lik6 ge3 gwo2 zap1 seng4 go3 jan4 zik1 hak1 zing1 san4 saai3
